align_terms: align a set of pandas expression terms by merging their axes and reindexing as needed
reconstruct_object: reconstruct a pandas object given its type, raw value, axes, dtype, and optional name
align_core_single_unary_op: align a single unary operation term returning its type and axes mapping
zip_axes_from_type: map axis positions to axis names for a pandas NDFrame type
filter_special_cases: wrap a function to short-circuit on single operands or non-pandas scalar terms
